environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on EC2 behind an ALB with no WAF attached. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards all traffic to the application on port 8080. No additional access control layers exist between the client and the application. The X-User-ID header is set by the client directly (no identity-aware proxy).

config.network: ALB public-facing, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 443
